Samenvatting Are you the Delivery Hero who makes sure orders reach customers on time? Then start now as a Delivery Driver at the largest supermarket chain in the Netherlands in Bleiswijk. Good work!Over de functieAs a delivery driver, you will be responsible for delivering online orders to customers' homes or offices on time. You will do this together with a friendly team. Your tasks include:
- Delivering groceries to the customer
- Checkout orders at the door (if the customer chooses to pay afterwards)
- Make sure the customer is satisfied with the received groceries
- Having a nice chat with the customer 

You will work a minimum of 3 shifts per week and have the choice of morning or evening shifts. On average, a shift lasts 6 hours. The guideline times for your shifts are: 
- Morning shift: Between 6 a.m. and 3 p.m.
- Evening shift: Between 3 p.m. and 11 p.m. 

You will be scheduled based on your availability! 
Over het bedrijfThe client is the largest supermarket chain in the Netherlands. They find it important that you can be yourself and that there is room for different ideas. You will receive active guidance to further develop yourself within the company.
Wat wij vragen- At least 1 year in possession of your driver's license B
- Available 3 to 6 days a week, once every two weeks on Saturday- You are communicatively strong in the Enligsh language

Wat wij bieden- Salary of € 16,37 gross per hour (including 8.1% ADV bonus, from age 18)
- End-of-year bonus of 3.46% after 13 weeks
- Travel allowance up to € 0.21 (up to 45 km)
- 8,33% vacation allowance
- Pension scheme
- Extensive familiarisation program

Meer informatieAre you the new delivery hero in Bleiswijk? You can apply within 2 minutes. Any questions? Thomas is happy to answer them at +31 6 237 235 54 (also Whatsapp) or at t.dupuis@carriere.com. Good job!

Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you interested in high-tech technology? Then this could be your next step. As an Assembler at ASML, you will work on lithography machines that are used to produce microchips for the world's most advanced technologies. You will work in ASML's cleanroom factory, a unique and highly technological working environment where precision, quality, and teamwork are essential. You do not need to know everything from day one. At ASML, you learn by doing and develop your skills step by step through training, guidance, and hands-on experience. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and become part of a team that builds complex systems with the highest level of accuracy. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working with your hands, have an eye for detail, and understand the importance of working accurately when assembling complex systems. You enjoy working as part of a team and are willing to help colleagues when needed. At the same time, you take responsibility for your own work and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative when you encounter a problem. You remain calm when priorities change and approach technical challenges in a practical and structured way. You are eager to learn and open to feedback. Whether you are already experienced in mechanical assembly or are looking to take the next step in your technical career, your motivation and willingness to develop are important. Education and technical experience A vocational qualification (MBO level 3 or 4) or a bachelor's degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, or a comparable discipline. Hands-on experience in a technical production or service environment. Experience with mechanical assembly, testing, adjustment, and troubleshooting. Experience working with both larger mechanical components a

fine mechanical parts. Ability to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions. Good command of English, both written and spoken, for daily communication and documentation. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will work in a unique high-tech environment where you can develop your technical skills and contribute to technology that is used all over the world. You will receive extensive training and guidance and have the opportunity to build a long-term career within an international organization. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €3,771, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance. An additional 0.65% ADV allowance. A 13th-month salary. An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow. As an Assembler, you will build complex systems step by step, following clear work instructions and technical drawings. Work in an open kitchen, interacting directly with guests. Handle administrative tasks such as processing orders, carrying out quality checks and completing weekly reports.
